card.title: LANCASTER Mk I
card.flavorText: The Avro Lancaster was a British four-engine heavy bomber used by the Royal Air Force (RAF) during WWII. The aircraft had a standard crew of 7 men, and it had the greatest bomb carrying capacity of all WWII bombers, which meant it could carry the biggest bombs the RAF had in their arsenal. The Lancaster was first used in the strategic bombing offensive over Europe in 1942 and after that it operated in almost every major bombing raid in the European conflict.
